settings.heading: Know your grade
settings.text: Every slab tells a story. Step through the scale to see exactly what separates a Gem Mint 10 from a well-loved 1.
settings.note: Descriptions follow PSA's published standards. BGS, CGC, SGC and TAG use similar 1–10 scales with half-point grades in between.

settings.label: Gem Mint
settings.description: A virtually perfect card: four sharp corners, sharp focus, full original gloss and no staining. Centering around 55/45 or better on the front.

settings.label: Mint
settings.description: A superb card with just one minor flaw — a tiny wax stain on the back, a small print spot or slightly off-white borders. Centering about 60/40 or better.

settings.label: Near Mint–Mint
settings.description: Looks Mint at a glance. Allows a very slight fray on one or two corners, a minor print imperfection or slightly off-white borders. Centering about 65/35.

settings.label: Near Mint
settings.description: Slight surface wear visible on close inspection and light fraying on some corners. Most of the original gloss remains. Centering about 70/30.

settings.label: Excellent–Mint
settings.description: Visible surface wear or a print defect, light scratches, slight edge notching and some loss of gloss. Corners may show fraying. Centering about 80/20.

settings.label: Excellent
settings.description: Very minor corner rounding becomes evident, with surface wear, light scratches and some chipping along the edges. Centering about 85/15.

settings.label: Very Good–Excellent
settings.description: Slightly rounded corners, noticeable surface wear and scuffing, and some loss of gloss. A light crease may be visible. Centering about 85/15.

settings.label: Very Good
settings.description: Rounded corners, obvious surface wear and possible light creasing. Most of the original gloss is gone and borders may be yellowed. Centering about 90/10.

settings.label: Good
settings.description: Heavy corner wear, scratching, surface staining and several creases, with significant gloss loss — but the card is still fully intact.

settings.label: Poor
settings.description: Extreme wear: heavy creases, scuffing, missing pieces or major defects that affect the card's structure. Still identifiable — and often still treasured.
